multi_table_questions.sql_hint: SELECT a.work_date, a.clock_in_time, wss.start_time FROM attendances a JOIN work_shift_schedules wss ON wss.shift_id = a.shift_id AND wss.day_of_week = EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM a.work_date) WHERE a.user_id = %(uid)s AND a.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY a.work_date DESC LIMIT 20
multi_table_questions.note: day_of_week 1-7 khop ISODOW; nho loc is_deleted

multi_table_questions.gold_sql: WITH ot AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.approved_date)::int AS thang, COUNT(*) AS so_don, SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.clock_out_time - o.clock_in_time))/3600) AS gio_chi_tiet FROM overtime_records o WHERE o.requestor_id = %(uid)s AND o.status = 'accepted' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.approved_date) = %(year)s GROUP BY 1) SELECT ot.thang, ot.gio_chi_tiet, mt.total_actual_ot_hours AS gio_tong_hop FROM ot JOIN monthly_timesheets mt ON mt.period_month = ot.thang AND mt.user_id = %(uid)s WHERE mt.period_year = %(year)s ORDER BY ot.thang LIMIT 100
multi_table_questions.question: Tổng giờ OT chi tiết trong đơn có khớp với giờ OT tổng hợp trên bảng công tháng này không?
multi_table_questions.join_kind: doi chieu (2 SELECT doc lap hoac subquery)
multi_table_questions.variant: SUM chi tiet vs cot tong hop total_actual_ot_hours
multi_table_questions.sql_hint: Dung requestor_id cho overtime_records, user_id cho monthly_timesheets; gom theo thang/nam roi so sanh
multi_table_questions.note: De test kha nang LLM tu chon cot user_col dung cho tung bang

multi_table_questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.period_month, p.overtime_pay, COALESCE(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.clock_out_time - o.clock_in_time))/3600), 0) AS gio_ot FROM payrolls p LEFT JOIN overtime_records o ON o.requestor_id = p.user_id AND o.requestor_id = %(uid)s AND o.status = 'accepted' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.approved_date) = p.period_month AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.approved_date) = p.period_year WHERE p.user_id = %(uid)s AND p.period_year = %(year)s GROUP BY p.period_month, p.overtime_pay ORDER BY p.period_month LIMIT 100
multi_table_questions.question: Tiền OT trong phiếu lương tháng này có tương xứng với tổng giờ OT thực tế của tôi không?
multi_table_questions.join_kind: doi chieu tien (overtime_pay) vs gio (SUM EPOCH)
multi_table_questions.variant: tien vs gio
multi_table_questions.sql_hint: Lay p.overtime_pay theo thang + SUM gio OT accepted cung thang tu approved_date

multi_table_questions.gold_sql: WITH don AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM q.from_date)::int AS thang, COALESCE(SUM(q.paid_leave_days), 0) AS ngay_theo_don FROM leave_requests q WHERE q.requestor_id = %(uid)s AND q.status = 'accepted' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q.from_date) = %(year)s GROUP BY 1) SELECT don.thang, don.ngay_theo_don, mt.paid_leave_days AS ngay_tren_cong FROM don JOIN monthly_timesheets mt ON mt.period_month = don.thang AND mt.user_id = %(uid)s WHERE mt.period_year = %(year)s ORDER BY don.thang LIMIT 100
multi_table_questions.question: Số ngày nghỉ phép trên bảng công tháng này có khớp với đơn nghỉ đã duyệt của tôi không?

multi_table_questions.variant: phat hien lech so lieu
multi_table_questions.sql_hint: monthly_timesheets.user_id + leave_requests.requestor_id deu = %(uid)s

multi_table_questions.gold_sql: SELECT 'Phep con lai: ' || (u.annual_leave_days - u.used_leave_days)::text AS thong_tin FROM users u WHERE u.user_id = %(uid)s UNION ALL SELECT 'Don cho duyet: ' || lr.from_date::text || ' -> ' || lr.to_date::text FROM leave_requests lr WHERE lr.requestor_id = %(uid)s AND lr.status = 'pending' LIMIT 100
multi_table_questions.question: Tôi còn bao nhiêu ngày phép, và hiện có đơn xin nghỉ nào đang chờ duyệt không?
multi_table_questions.join_kind: 2 ve ca nhan (so du + don pending)
multi_table_questions.variant: tong hop phep: con lai + cho duyet
multi_table_questions.sql_hint: users cho annual-used; leave_requests loc status pending, requestor_id = %(uid)s

multi_table_questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.contract_type, c.contract_start_date, c.contract_end_date, s.base_salary, s.pay_frequency FROM user_contracts c JOIN salaries s ON s.user_id = c.user_id AND s.user_id = %(uid)s AND s.is_active = TRUE WHERE c.user_id = %(uid)s AND c.is_active = TRUE LIMIT 100

multi_table_questions.gold_sql: SELECT u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, p.phone_number, p.personal_email, b.bank_name, b.account_number FROM users u JOIN user_profiles p ON p.user_id = u.user_id AND p.user_id = %(uid)s LEFT JOIN user_bank_accounts b ON b.user_id = u.user_id AND b.user_id = %(uid)s AND b.is_default = TRUE WHERE u.user_id = %(uid)s LIMIT 100

multi_table_questions.gold_sql: WITH luong AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.net_pay), 0) AS tong FROM payrolls p WHERE p.user_id = %(uid)s AND p.period_year = %(year)s), gio AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mt.actual_work_hours), 0) AS tong FROM monthly_timesheets mt WHERE mt.user_id = %(uid)s AND mt.period_year = %(year)s) SELECT luong.tong AS tong_thu_nhap, gio.tong AS tong_gio, luong.tong / NULLIF(gio.tong, 0) AS binh_quan_moi_gio FROM luong, gio LIMIT 100
